Real assistant content preserved 10/10 (LLMMetrics fired every session, vLLM tokens advanced). Fix 1 (enable_thinking=False) untouched. Zero Anthropic calls in window. HOWEVER the headline metric publish_end_to_first_returned_audio_ms p95 is 8510 ms (cycle-1 was 7010 ms), tts_ttfb_ms p95 is 2734 ms (cycle-1 was 2956 ms), and tts_total_ms_max p95 is 7403 ms. The e2e p95 did NOT improve materially despite preroll being decisively dropped, because the filler-bridge utterance (worker.py:830-859, fires on user speech-end) now occupies the slot the preroll occupied; the synthetic_caller harness's reply-detection threshold (peak > 1000) fires on filler audio tail OR Fish's slow streaming TTS. The harness cannot distinguish 'filler audio' from 'real LLM-content audio' so the headline metric mixes both. Per directive decision rule: E2E p95 ~8500ms is in the ~7000ms ballpark, not <=3300ms, → HARNESS_BUG suspected → flag for cycle-2-debug, NOT cycle-2b. Fix 1 + cycle-2a edit both stay; no rollback because real replies remained 10/10.

deltas_vs_cycle_1_20260425T123607Z.interpretation: cycle-2a is a functional success on its stated goal (preroll dropped) but a measurement failure on the e2e gate. The synthetic_caller's reply-detection threshold cannot distinguish filler from real LLM-content audio, and Fish TTS is the binding bottleneck (full-utterance render p95=7403ms). The e2e p95 regression is largely STT cold-start (+85ms median) plus filler audio being treated as 'reply' by the harness.

exact_bottleneck: Fish TTS streaming. tts_total_ms_max p95 = 7403 ms means Fish is taking up to 7.4 seconds to render the full assistant utterance. tts_ttfb_ms p95 = 2734 ms means first audio byte takes up to 2.7 s. The preroll-drop did NOT change Fish; it only removed the 2400ms preroll prefix. Real e2e improvement requires either Fish optimization (MPS/batching/torch.compile path) OR backend swap (Cartesia Sonic-3 ~150-250 ms TTFB) — both out of scope this cycle per directive constraints (no Cartesia, no MPS/CUDA changes, no Fish internals).

The latter approximates 'first useful assistant audio'. This is the ONLY way to get a clean publish_end_to_first_useful_assistant_audio_ms metric with the current always-on filler bridge.
